from solution import alternating_prefixes
assert alternating_prefixes('5,2,3,1') == '5,3,6,5'
assert alternating_prefixes('-1,-2,-3') == '-1,1,-2'
assert alternating_prefixes('0') == '0'
assert alternating_prefixes('--1') is None
assert alternating_prefixes('') is None
